verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no retrievable, timestamped audit trail of case decisions. What it does show is adjacent only: a marketing line about 'fully auditable agentic automation', webhooks that fire when a manual review occurs, and Evaluation responses that return workflow results. None of these establishes an audit-log or decision-history capability that records both human and automated decisions with timestamps, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can retrieve a timestamped audit trail of human and automated case decisions
